rdf:Description.rdfs:label: decommission
rdf:Description.rdfs:comment: A relationship has specific context implications for a product's retirement and/or decommissioning.
Energy consumed during inference time by an AI model that is being used in the AI system.
Assessment of an Element for export control classification.

rdf:Description.rdfs:label: model
rdf:Description.rdfs:comment: The Element is a machine learning or artificial intelligence model.
Potentially noisy elements of the dataset.
Timestamp of impact statement.
Class that describes a process.

rdf:Description.rdfs:label: diskImage
rdf:Description.rdfs:comment: The Element refers to a disk image that can be written to a disk, booted in a VM, etc. A disk image typically contains most or all of the components necessary to boot, such as bootloaders, kernels, firmware, userspace, etc.
Class that describes an instance of Hardware.
A license addition that is not listed on the SPDX Exceptions List.

rdf:Description.rdfs:label: lei
rdf:Description.rdfs:comment: The [Legal Entity Identifier (LEI)](https://www.gleif.org/en/organizational-identity/introducing-the-legal-entity-identifier-lei) is a 20-character, alphanumeric code based on the [ISO 17442](https://www.iso.org/standard/78829.html) standard developed by the International Organization for Standardization.
Provides a CVSS version 3 assessment for a vulnerability.
A product specification (product spec) is a detailed document that outlines the technical, functional, and design requirements of a product.
A prescribed alteration of a product.

rdf:Description.rdfs:label: vulnerableCodeNotPresent
rdf:Description.rdfs:comment: The product is not affected because the code underlying the vulnerability is not present in the product.

rdf:Description.rdfs:label: requirementUUID
rdf:Description.rdfs:comment: The UUID used by a requirements management or any other lifecycle management tool to uniquely identify a requirement item. UUID, or universally unique ID, is a standard term in requirements engineering.

rdf:Description.rdfs:label: pretrainedOn
rdf:Description.rdfs:comment: The `from` Element has been pretrained on the `to` Element(s).

rdf:Description.rdfs:label: urlScheme
rdf:Description.rdfs:comment: [Uniform Resource Identifier (URI) Schemes](https://www.iana.org/assignments/uri-schemes/uri-schemes.xhtml). The scheme used in order to locate a resource.

rdf:Description.rdfs:label: none
rdf:Description.rdfs:comment: When a CVSS score is 0.0.
Type of the model used in the AI software.

rdf:Description.rdfs:label: other
rdf:Description.rdfs:comment: Other exploit catalogs.
Information related to physical hardware.
This process is used to determine the state of an affected Element.

rdf:Description.rdfs:label: fixedBy
rdf:Description.rdfs:comment: Designates a `from` Vulnerability has been fixed by the `to` Agent(s).

rdf:Description.rdfs:label: reportedBy
rdf:Description.rdfs:comment: Designates a `from` Vulnerability was first reported to a project, vendor, or tracking database for formal identification by each `to` Agent.

rdf:Description.rdfs:label: specification
rdf:Description.rdfs:comment: A specification is a detailed document (or set of documents) that describes the requirements, design, behavior, or other characteristics of a system, component, or process so that all stakeholders have a clear, unambiguous reference.

rdf:Description.rdfs:label: functionalSafety
rdf:Description.rdfs:comment: The element follows the FunctionalSafety profile specification.

rdf:Description.rdfs:label: documentation
rdf:Description.rdfs:comment: The Element is documentation.

rdf:Description.rdfs:label: underInvestigationFor
rdf:Description.rdfs:comment: The `from` Vulnerability impact is being investigated for each `to` Element. The use of the `underInvestigationFor` type is constrained to `VexUnderInvestigationVulnAssessmentRelationship` classed relationships.

rdf:Description.rdfs:label: isil
rdf:Description.rdfs:comment: [International Standard Identifier for Libraries and Related Organizations (ISIL)](https://slks.dk/english/work-areas/libraries-and-literature/library-standards/isil/) is a unique alphanumeric code for identifying libraries, archives, museums, and related organizations standardized by [ISO 15511](https://www.iso.org/standard/77849.html). It consists of a prefix—which may be an ISO 3166-1 alpha-2 country code or a non-country code assigned by the ISIL Registration Authority—followed by a unit identifier, totaling up to 16 characters (e.g., `FI-Sipoo-Sö` or `ZDB-1-SBD`). Valid symbols include any alphanumeric character, solidus (`/`), hyphen-minus (`-`), or colon.
The CreateProcess refers to the abstract process class that can be used to represent the process of creation of a product.

rdf:Description.rdfs:label: cpe22
rdf:Description.rdfs:comment: [Common Platform Enumeration Specification 2.2](https://cpe.mitre.org/files/cpe-specification_2.2.pdf).
A canonical, unique, immutable identifier.

rdf:Description.rdfs:label: performedBy
rdf:Description.rdfs:comment: Every `from` action is performedBy `to` Agent.
Abstract ancestor class for all vulnerability assessments.

rdf:Description.rdfs:label: componentNotPresent
rdf:Description.rdfs:comment: The software is not affected because the vulnerable component is not in the product.

rdf:Description.rdfs:label: sha1
rdf:Description.rdfs:comment: SHA-1, a secure hashing algorithm, as defined in [RFC 3174](https://datatracker.ietf.org/doc/rfc3174/).

rdf:Description.rdfs:label: serious
rdf:Description.rdfs:comment: The highest level of risk posed by an AI system.

rdf:Description.rdfs:label: file
rdf:Description.rdfs:comment: The Element is a single file which can be independently distributed (configuration file, statically linked binary, Kubernetes deployment, etc.).

rdf:Description.rdfs:label: lite
rdf:Description.rdfs:comment: The element follows the Lite profile specification.
Abstract class for additional text intended to be added to a License, but which is not itself a standalone License.

rdf:Description.rdfs:label: formalStandard
rdf:Description.rdfs:comment: A formal standard is a standard ratified by a recognized standards-development organization and published as a normative reference.
Links a vulnerability and one or more elements designating the latter as products not affected by the vulnerability.
Designates elements as products where the impact of a vulnerability is being investigated.
The record of destruction is entered in this action.

rdf:Description.rdfs:label: securityPolicy
rdf:Description.rdfs:comment: A reference to instructions for reporting newly discovered security vulnerabilities for a package.

rdf:Description.rdfs:label: isrc
rdf:Description.rdfs:comment: [International Standard Recording Code (ISRC)](https://isrc.ifpi.org/isrc-standard) is a unique 12-character alphanumeric identifier for sound recordings and music video recordings standardized by [ISO 3901](https://www.iso.org/standard/64817.html). While the "ISRC" label and grouping hyphens used for human readability, they shall be omitted when the identifier is stored electronically (e.g., `USCA28900153`).
This individual element was defined by the spec.
Specifies the type of an external reference.
The amount or measure of a bulk product.

rdf:Description.rdfs:label: endOfSupport
rdf:Description.rdfs:comment: There is a defined end of support for the artifact from the supplier. This may also be referred to as end of life. There is a validUntilDate that can be used to signal when support ends for the artifact.

rdf:Description.rdfs:label: mavenCentral
rdf:Description.rdfs:comment: A reference to a Maven repository artifact. The artifact locator format is defined in the [Maven documentation](https://maven.apache.org/guides/mini/guide-naming-conventions.html) and looks like `groupId:artifactId[:version]`.

rdf:Description.rdfs:label: assistiveAutomation
rdf:Description.rdfs:comment: Level 1 - Assistive automation. The system assists an operator.

rdf:Description.rdfs:label: altDownloadLocation
rdf:Description.rdfs:comment: A reference to an alternative download location.

rdf:Description.rdfs:label: amendedBy
rdf:Description.rdfs:comment: The `from` Element is amended by each `to` Element.
RequirementVerification class defines the base properties of a verification.
CreationAction represents an event of product creation.
The headquartersLocation defines the location of the organization's headquarters.

rdf:Description.rdfs:label: orcidid
rdf:Description.rdfs:comment: [Open Researcher and Contributor ID (ORCID) iD](https://info.orcid.org/what-is-orcid/) is a unique identifier for authors and contributors in scholarly communication; as a subset of the International Standard Name Identifier (ISNI), it typically appears as a URI such as `https://orcid.org/0000-0002-1825-0097`.

rdf:Description.rdfs:label: inconclusive
rdf:Description.rdfs:comment: Inconclusive refers to a result or outcome from a verification, test, or analysis that cannot be clearly classified as either positive (successful, pass) or negative (failed, reject). An inconclusive result means there was not enough clear evidence, data, or signal to make a definitive determination, and further investigation or additional testing is necessary. An inconclusive result always shall need a comment on it.
Dimensions generally refer to measurable extents or attributes that define the size, shape, or scale of an object, system, or concept.

rdf:Description.rdfs:label: notAutomated
rdf:Description.rdfs:comment: Level 0 - Not automated. No automation. The operator fully controls the system.
Conveys information about how VEX status was determined.
EvidenceType refers to categories of documented or observable proof used to verify compliance, qualification, or performance

rdf:Description.rdfs:label: isni
rdf:Description.rdfs:comment: [International Standard Name Identifier (ISNI)](https://isni.org/page/what-is-isni/) is a unique identifier used to distinguish the public identities of parties involved in the creation, production, and distribution of media content. Standardized by [ISO 27729](https://www.iso.org/standard/87177.html), it consists of 16 characters—15 digits plus a final check character—and is often represented as a URI, such as `https://isni.org/isni/000000012146438X`.
Provides the location of an external reference.

rdf:Description.rdfs:label: evidence
rdf:Description.rdfs:comment: The Element is the evidence that a specification or requirement has been fulfilled.

rdf:Description.rdfs:label: bom
rdf:Description.rdfs:comment: A reference to a bill of materials related to a package.
Weight to express relevance in de minimis consideration.
A concrete subclass of AnyLicenseInfo used by Individuals in the ExpandedLicensing profile.

rdf:Description.rdfs:label: hasAssociatedVulnerability
rdf:Description.rdfs:comment: Used to associate a `from` Artifact with each `to` Vulnerability.

The percentile of the current probability score.
Class that describes a physical instance of Hardware.
Hyperparameter used to build the AI model contained in the AI package.
An Individual Value for License when no assertion can be made about its actual value.
Identifies the tooling that was used during the creation of the Element.
Refers to any unit of content that can be associated with a distribution of software.

rdf:Description.rdfs:label: deployed
rdf:Description.rdfs:comment: SBOM provides an inventory of software that is present on a system. This may be an assembly of other SBOMs that combines analysis of configuration options, and examination of execution behavior in a (potentially simulated) deployment environment.
This property is used to denote the root Element(s) of a tree of elements contained in a BOM.

rdf:Description.rdfs:label: analysis
rdf:Description.rdfs:comment: Analytical evaluating of data, designs, or processes methodically to verify correctness against standards or expectations. Typical analysis methods are FMEA, FTA, STPA, static analysis for MISRA compliance etc.

rdf:Description.rdfs:label: tracedToDetail
rdf:Description.rdfs:comment: the `from` Requirement is refined and further elaborated by each `to` Requirement, which contains more detailed implementation information.
Denote whether a CVE is present in an exploit catalog.

rdf:Description.rdfs:label: locatedAt
rdf:Description.rdfs:comment: `from` element located at a specific `to` location. A time period is optional.

rdf:Description.rdfs:label: vcs
rdf:Description.rdfs:comment: A reference to a version control system related to a software artifact.

rdf:Description.rdfs:label: expandedLicensing
rdf:Description.rdfs:comment: The element follows the ExpandedLicensing profile specification.
A distinct unit representing a requirement, as used in systems, software, and hardware engineering.

rdf:Description.rdfs:label: test
rdf:Description.rdfs:comment: A relationship has specific context implications during an element's testing phase, during development.

rdf:Description.rdfs:label: function
rdf:Description.rdfs:comment: Simulation the function of the hardware.

rdf:Description.rdfs:label: other
rdf:Description.rdfs:comment: Used when the type does not match any of the other options.
Specifies the CVSS base, temporal, threat, or environmental severity type.

rdf:Description.rdfs:label: build
rdf:Description.rdfs:comment: The element follows the Build profile specification.

rdf:Description.rdfs:label: bower
rdf:Description.rdfs:comment: A reference to a Bower package. The package locator format, looks like `package#version`, is defined in the "install" section of [Bower API documentation](https://bower.io/docs/api/#install).

**DEPRECATED in SPDX 3.1.** Use [/Software/artifactSize](../../Software/Properties/artifactSize.md) instead.
Size of the dataset.

rdf:Description.rdfs:label: draft
rdf:Description.rdfs:comment: in production

rdf:Description.rdfs:label: software
rdf:Description.rdfs:comment: The element follows the Software profile specification.

rdf:Description.rdfs:label: socialMedia
rdf:Description.rdfs:comment: A reference to a social media channel for a package.
Records the storage of a product.
An Organization representing the SPDX Project.
Specification basis for the export control classification.

rdf:Description.rdfs:label: usesTool
rdf:Description.rdfs:comment: The `from` Element uses each `to` Element as a tool, during a LifecycleScopeType period.

rdf:Description.rdfs:label: phoneNumber
rdf:Description.rdfs:comment: Phone number; A string of decimal digits that uniquely indicates the network termination point defined in [RFC 3966](https://datatracker.ietf.org/doc/rfc3966/) Section 5.
The DefinedType class associates a specific type with its defined source.

rdf:Description.rdfs:label: audit
rdf:Description.rdfs:comment: An examination typically focusing on compliance with policies, standards, or regulations. Usually this is done during an audit meeting, while the assessment also involves deep and detailed reviews of work products (e.g. requirements, verification specifications, reports etc.)

rdf:Description.rdfs:label: other
rdf:Description.rdfs:comment: Used to store extra information about an Element which is not part of a review (e.g. extra information provided during the creation of the Element).
EvidenceRelationship defines the association between pieces of evidence and EvaluationResult.
A characterization of some aspect of an Element that is associated with the Element in a generalized fashion.
Specifies the time when a vulnerability was published.
A license that is listed on the SPDX License List.
The point in time when an element or an action ends, becomes no longer applicable, or becomes no longer valid.
Describes a relationship between one or more elements.

rdf:Description.rdfs:label: buildSystem
rdf:Description.rdfs:comment: A reference to a build system used to create or publish the package.

rdf:Description.rdfs:label: iscc
rdf:Description.rdfs:comment: [International Standard Content Code (ISCC)](https://iscc.io/) is a content-derived identifier standardized by [ISO 24138](https://www.iso.org/standard/77899.html) for identifying digital assets. ISCC can be used in conjunction with other schemes, such as DOI, ISAN, ISBN, ISRC, ISSN and ISWC. A standard ISCC-CODE is build from multiple ISCC-UNITs. Each unit serve a different purpose. An ISCC-CODE typically look like `ISCC:KACT4EBWK27737D2AYCJRAL5Z36G76RFRMO4554RU26HZ4ORJGIVHDI`.
Class that describes an action that has occurred.
ResponsibilityChangeAction refers to the transfer of responsibility from one party to another.
Confidentiality level of the data points contained in the dataset.
Provides information about the type of an SBOM.

rdf:Description.rdfs:label: low
rdf:Description.rdfs:comment: Low/no risk is posed by an AI system.
Base domain class from which all other SPDX 3 domain classes derive.

rdf:Description.rdfs:label: attend
rdf:Description.rdfs:comment: The vulnerability requires attention from the organization's internal, supervisory-level individuals. Necessary actions include requesting assistance or information about the vulnerability, and may involve publishing a notification either internally and/or externally. CISA recommends remediating Attend vulnerabilities sooner than standard update timelines.
Connects a vulnerability and an element designating the element as a product affected by the vulnerability.
Abstract class representing a License or an OrLaterOperator.

rdf:Description.rdfs:label: other
rdf:Description.rdfs:comment: A relationship has other specific context information necessary to capture that the above set of enumerations does not handle.

rdf:Description.rdfs:label: runtimeAnalysisReport
rdf:Description.rdfs:comment: A reference to a runtime analysis report for a package.
References the Element on the left-hand side of a relationship.

rdf:Description.rdfs:label: library
rdf:Description.rdfs:comment: The Element is a software library.

rdf:Description.rdfs:label: extension
rdf:Description.rdfs:comment: The element follows the Extension profile specification.
Information about the relationship between two Elements.

rdf:Description.rdfs:label: firmware
rdf:Description.rdfs:comment: The Element provides low level control over a device's hardware.
A prescribed change to a product's location.

rdf:Description.rdfs:label: runtime
rdf:Description.rdfs:comment: SBOM generated through instrumenting the system running the software, to capture only components present in the system, as well as external call-outs or dynamically loaded components. In some contexts, this may also be referred to as an "Instrumented" or "Dynamic" SBOM.
A Package that contains a dataset.
HarvestAction represents the act of creating a product by directly extracting goods or materials from nature.
Requirements can be categorized into various types based on their focus, purpose, and scope.
An assertion made in relation to one or more elements.
This individual element was defined by the spec.
Information related to virtual hardware simulation.
Provides an unambiguous mechanism for conveying a URI fragment portion of an Element ID.

rdf:Description.rdfs:label: source
rdf:Description.rdfs:comment: The Element is a single or a collection of source files.

A key with an Element.
UnitofMeasure specify information structures through industry standards for Units of Measure, Quantity Kinds, Dimensions and Data Types.
Results of general safety risk assessment of the AI system.
Unit in which energy is measured.
Describes a certain part of a file.

rdf:Description.rdfs:label: other
rdf:Description.rdfs:comment: The Element doesn't fit into any of the other categories.
An SPDX Element containing an SPDX license expression string.

rdf:Description.rdfs:label: testedOn
rdf:Description.rdfs:comment: The `from` Element has been tested on the `to` Element(s).
An actual change to a product's location.

rdf:Description.sh:message: https://spdx.org/rdf/3.1/terms/ExpandedLicensing/License is an abstract class and should not be instantiated directly. Instantiate a subclass instead.

rdf:Description.rdfs:comment: A state is an instance that describes what a system, component, subsystem, process, or project has achieved at any given time.
Specifies an Element as subject of an assessment.

rdf:Description.rdfs:label: hasRequirement
rdf:Description.rdfs:comment: The `from` Element has a requirement on each `to` Element, during a LifecycleScopeType period.
Provides information about the creation of the Element.
Class that describes an instance of VirtualHardware.
Identifies the full text of a LicenseAddition, in SPDX templating format.

rdf:Description.rdfs:label: bic
rdf:Description.rdfs:comment: Business Identifier Code (BIC), also known as SWIFT-BIC or SWIFT code, is a unique 8 or 11-character alphanumeric code standardized by [ISO 9362](https://www.iso.org/standard/84108.html) to identify financial and non-financial institutions (e.g., `BBWCUS33`).

rdf:Description.rdfs:label: blake2b512
rdf:Description.rdfs:comment: BLAKE2b algorithm with a digest size of 512, as defined in [RFC 7693](https://datatracker.ietf.org/doc/rfc7693/) Section 4.

rdf:Description.rdfs:label: hasDataFile
rdf:Description.rdfs:comment: The `from` Element treats each `to` Element as a data file. A data file is an artifact that stores data required or optional for the `from` Element's functionality. A data file can be a database file, an index file, a log file, an AI model file, a calibration data file, a temporary file, a backup file, and more. For AI training dataset, test dataset, test artifact, configuration data, build input data, and build output data, please consider using the more specific relationship types: `trainedOn`, `testedOn`, `hasTest`, `configures`, `hasInput`, and `hasOutput`, respectively. This relationship does not imply dependency.

rdf:Description.rdfs:label: x509Cert
rdf:Description.rdfs:comment: A reference to an X.509 certificate as defined in [RFC 1422](https://datatracker.ietf.org/doc/rfc1422/). The media type shall be one of application/x-x509-ca-cert or application/x-x509-user-cert.

rdf:Description.rdfs:label: operations
rdf:Description.rdfs:comment: The element follows the Operations profile specification.

Provide the enumeration of possible decisions in the [Stakeholder-Specific Vulnerability Categorization (SSVC) decision tree](https://www.cisa.gov/stakeholder-specific-vulnerability-categorization-ssvc).

rdf:Description.rdfs:label: nuget
rdf:Description.rdfs:comment: A reference to a NuGet package. The package locator format is defined in the [NuGet documentation](https://docs.nuget.org) and looks like `package/version`.
A physical location is a tangible, geographically identifiable place where objects, people, or assets exist or operate.

rdf:Description.rdfs:label: vulnerableCodeCannotBeControlledByAdversary
rdf:Description.rdfs:comment: The vulnerable component is present, and the component contains the vulnerable code. However, vulnerable code is used in such a way that an attacker cannot mount any anticipated attack.

rdf:Description.rdfs:label: hasDistributionArtifact
rdf:Description.rdfs:comment: The `from` Element is distributed as an artifact in each `to` Element (e.g. an RPM or archive file).
A Package that contains AI software or an AI model.
An entity that is authorized to issue identification credentials.

rdf:Description.rdfs:label: other
rdf:Description.rdfs:comment: Any other specialized or custom verification method that fits the context.
This individual element was defined by the spec.
Provides a License author's preferred text to indicate that a file is covered by the License.
Refers to any object that stores content on a computer.

rdf:Description.rdfs:label: serializedInArtifact

rdf:Description.rdfs:label: requirement
rdf:Description.rdfs:comment: The Element provides a requirement needed as input for another Element.

rdf:Description.rdfs:label: finetunedOn
rdf:Description.rdfs:comment: The `from` Element has been finetuned on the `to` Element(s).

rdf:Description.rdfs:label: affects
rdf:Description.rdfs:comment: The `from` Vulnerability, Action or DefinedProcess affects each `to` Element.

rdf:Description.rdfs:label: productMetadata
rdf:Description.rdfs:comment: A reference to additional product metadata such as reference within organization's product catalog.

rdf:Description.rdfs:label: partialAutomation
rdf:Description.rdfs:comment: Level 2 - Partial automation or task automation. Some sub-functions of the system are fully automated while the system remain under control of an external agent. The system can perform actions for an approved task without requiring the agent's continuous direct control.

rdf:Description.rdfs:label: update
rdf:Description.rdfs:comment: A relationship has specific context implications for a product update.
The location for dropping off or delivering a package or item.

rdf:Description.rdfs:label: analyzed
rdf:Description.rdfs:comment: SBOM generated through analysis of artifacts (e.g., executables, packages, containers, and virtual machine images) after its build. Such analysis generally requires a variety of heuristics. In some contexts, this may also be referred to as a "3rd party" SBOM.
The boundary definition is used to define boundaries.

rdf:Description.rdfs:label: securityAdversaryModel

ResponsibilityChangeProcess refers to the process of transferring responsibility from one party to another.

rdf:Description.rdfs:label: privacyAssessment

rdf:Description.rdfs:label: application

rdf:Description.rdfs:label: eolNotice

Provides information about the completeness of relationships.

rdf:Description.rdfs:label: duns

rdf:Description.rdfs:label: configuration
rdf:Description.rdfs:comment: The Element is configuration data.

rdf:Description.rdfs:label: altWebPage
rdf:Description.rdfs:comment: A reference to an alternative web page.

rdf:Description.rdfs:label: adler32
rdf:Description.rdfs:comment: Adler-32 checksum is part of the widely used zlib compression library as defined in [RFC 1950](https://datatracker.ietf.org/doc/rfc1950/) Section 2.3.

Gitoids calculated on the Artifact Input Manifest (Input Manifest Identifier) should be recorded in the SPDX 3 Element's externalIdentifier property. A gitoid of type blob is a unique hash of a binary artifact. A gitoid may represent either an [Artifact Identifier](https://github.com/omnibor/spec/blob/eb1ee5c961c16215eb8709b2975d193a2007a35d/spec/SPEC.md#artifact-identifier-types) for the software artifact or an [Input Manifest Identifier](https://github.com/omnibor/spec/blob/eb1ee5c961c16215eb8709b2975d193a2007a35d/spec/SPEC.md#input-manifest-identifier) for the software artifact's associated [Artifact Input Manifest](https://github.com/omnibor/spec/blob/eb1ee5c961c16215eb8709b2975d193a2007a35d/spec/SPEC.md#artifact-input-manifest); this ambiguity exists because the Artifact Input Manifest is itself an artifact, and the gitoid of that artifact is its valid identifier. Gitoids calculated on software artifacts (Snippet, File, or Package Elements) should be recorded in the SPDX 3 SoftwareArtifact's contentIdentifier property. Gitoids calculated on the Artifact Input Manifest (Input Manifest Identifier) should be recorded in the SPDX 3 Element's externalIdentifier property. See [OmniBOR Specification](https://github.com/omnibor/spec/), a minimalistic specification for describing software [Artifact Dependency Graphs](https://github.com/omnibor/spec/blob/eb1ee5c961c16215eb8709b2975d193a2007a35d/spec/SPEC.md#artifact-dependency-graph-adg).
